label: Coinitial Grim Reaper pieces give spaced Grim Reaper pieces (inference)
rule: In linear time a spaced descent is coinitial: its clock readings fall below every real number
meaning: Strength order (linear time, any real clock): the local-pieces premise over coinitial populated descents gives it over spaced populated descents, because a descent whose slots last at least delta runs below every earlier moment. The converse fails: in the positive reals the spaced premises hold for every register frame while the coinitial premises do not both hold (MetricGrimReaper control 2). No premise is established.
